observations.why: Assertive, unhedged switch announcement with an operational 'we're switching' core, but it is a quoted position rendered through the memo author, with no settling performed in this segment itself; torn with decision, so the lower region is taken.
The memo author's heading performs the recording of settled decisions, which the listed items then carry.
Recorded under the 'Key decisions' heading as a settled migration, so the memo records the settling.
A flat benefit assertion about performance; it is stated as fact but is a justification rather than a settling act, so claim.
